summary: Add an inert, shard-aware pending wake-demand projection with source frontiers.

replay.detail: No authoritative claim or replay semantics change. Source triggers queue disposable metadata folds.

schema.detail: Adds versioned local wake-demand and pending-work tables, an indexed per-recipient demand read, source triggers and restartable 64-subject startup backfill from graph and mirrored shard sends. No bodies are copied into the projection.

rules.detail: Uses existing silent-tag and always-wakes classification. No new claim kinds, suspend decisions or wake actions.

compatibility.detail: No wire or client changes. Older writers maintain the durable pending queue through SQL triggers; returning readers refuse absence proof until queued work is folded. Independent source cursors are not compared across databases.

downtime.detail: First open performs the historical metadata backfill in bounded transactions. Subsequent opens resume any interrupted cursor and drain queued folds.

manual.detail: No configuration or manual migration is needed. This reader has no suspend or wake consumer.

recovery.detail: Only disposable local state is added. Original claims and shard lifecycle remain authoritative; an unavailable or lagging shard reports incomplete coverage instead of empty demand.
